name: GT Gold Holdings Limited
summary: GT Gold Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, processing, and refining of gold deposits in the People's Republic of China. The company provides gold concentrates, gold bullion, and other mineral products. It is also involved in scientific research and technical activities; trade agency and selling business; and AI technology development and application for mining operations. The company was formerly known as Grand T G Gold Holdings Limited and changed its name to GT Gold Holdings Limited in October 2024. GT Gold Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
